returns.allowed: Whether the proposal path is currently valid.

params.citizenProposalBondRequirement_: The minimum active stake required to open a citizen referendum.
params.citizenProposalFee_: The fee configured for citizen-origin proposals.
params.citizenQuorum_: The minimum turnout required for citizen-origin referenda.
params.congressProposalAuthority_: The Congress app used to validate real Congress proposal authority.
params.congressProposalFee_: The fee configured for Congress-origin proposals.
params.congressQuorum_: The minimum turnout required for Congress-origin referenda.
params.constitutionalForStakeThresholdBps_: The minimum supporting stake threshold in basis points.
params.constitutionalForVoterQuorum_: The minimum supporting-citizen headcount for constitutional amendments.
params.proposalFeeAsset_: The ERC20 token proposal fees are denominated in (LLM by convention).

params.againstVoterCount: The number of voters currently recorded against.
params.againstVotes: The total voting power recorded against.
params.electorateHeadcountSnapshot: The eligible electorate headcount stored when the referendum was created.
params.electorateVotingPowerSnapshot: The eligible electorate voting power stored when the referendum was created.
params.forVoterCount: The number of voters currently recorded in favor.
params.forVotes: The total voting power recorded in favor.
params.proposalOrigin: The proposal origin used to create the referendum.
params.requiresSupermajority: Whether the referendum must clear the constitutional double-threshold pass rule.

returns.outcome: The evaluated turnout, quorum, and pass outcome.

returns.feeAmount: The configured proposal fee amount in the fee asset's smallest units.

canCreateReferendum(uint8,uint8,address).notice: Returns whether the proposer may create a referendum for the given class and origin.

citizenEligibilityPolicy().notice: Returns the configured citizen eligibility policy address.

citizenProposalBondRequirement().notice: Returns the minimum active stake required for a citizen-origin referendum proposal.

congressProposalAuthority().notice: Returns the configured temporary Congress proposal authority address.

emergencyVotingDuration().notice: Returns the shorter minimum voting duration allowed for Congress-origin emergency measures.

evaluateOutcome(uint8,uint8,uint256,uint.notice: Evaluates the referendum outcome from final tallies using the configured pass rules.

maximumAdoptionDelay().notice: Returns the maximum post-vote adoption review delay a proposal may request.

minimumVotingDuration().notice: Returns the minimum referendum voting duration enforced by policy.

proposalFee(uint8).notice: Returns the configured proposal fee for a proposal origin.

proposalFeeAsset().notice: Returns the ERC20 token proposal fees are denominated in (LLM by convention).

standardAdoptionDelay().notice: Returns the standard post-vote adoption review delay.

votingPowerPolicy().notice: Returns the configured voting power policy address.
